import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, itertools, math
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
raw="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=[l.split() for l in raw.split("\n")];al=ls[0];BL={}
for r_ in ls[1:]:
    for b,v in zip(al,r_[1:]): BL[(r_[0],b)]=int(v)
def nw(s1,s2,go=11,ge=1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-10**9
    M=[[NEG]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)];Ix=[r[:] for r in M];Iy=[r[:] for r in M]
    pM=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)];pIx=[r[:] for r in pM];pIy=[r[:] for r in pM]
    M[0][0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i][0]=-go-ge*(i-1);pIx[i][0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0][j]=-go-ge*(j-1);pIy[0][j]=2
    Sr=[[BL.get((a,b),-2) for b in s2] for a in s1]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mp,Ixp,Iyp=M[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1];Mi,Ixi,Iyi=M[i],Ix[i],Iy[i];Si=Sr[i-1]
        pMi,pIxi,pIyi=pM[i],pIx[i],pIy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a,b,c=Mp[j-1],Ixp[j-1],Iyp[j-1]
            if a>=b and a>=c: Mi[j]=a+Si[j-1];pMi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Mi[j]=b+Si[j-1];pMi[j]=1
            else: Mi[j]=c+Si[j-1];pMi[j]=2
            a,b,c=Mp[j]-go,Ixp[j]-ge,Iyp[j]-go
            if a>=b and a>=c: Ixi[j]=a;pIxi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Ixi[j]=b;pIxi[j]=1
            else: Ixi[j]=c;pIxi[j]=2
            a,b,c=Mi[j-1]-go,Ixi[j-1]-go,Iyi[j-1]-ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Iyi[j]=a;pIyi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Iyi[j]=b;pIyi[j]=1
            else: Iyi[j]=c;pIyi[j]=2
    st=int(np.argmax([M[n][m],Ix[n][m],Iy[n][m]]));i,j=n,m;A=[];C=[];P=[pM,pIx,pIy]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: A.append("-");C.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append("-");i-=1;continue
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append(s2[j-1]);ns=P[0][i][j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append("-");ns=P[1][i][j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append("-");C.append(s2[j-1]);ns=P[2][i][j];j-=1;st=ns
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(C))
bases="TCAG"; aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={};i=0
for b1 in bases:
    for b2 in bases:
        for b3 in bases: CODON[b1+b2+b3]=aas[i];i+=1
def tr(s): return "".join(CODON.get(s[i:i+3].upper(),"X") for i in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
def syn(c):
    c=c.upper()
    if c not in CODON or CODON[c]=="*": return None
    return sum(1/3 for p in range(3) for b in "TCAG" if b!=c[p] and CODON[c[:p]+b+c[p+1:]]==CODON[c])
SYN={c:syn(c) for c in CODON}
def ng(cp):
    Sd=Nd=S=N=0.0
    for c1,c2 in cp:
        if c1 not in CODON or c2 not in CODON or CODON[c1]=="*" or CODON[c2]=="*": continue
        s1s,s2s=SYN[c1],SYN[c2]
        S+=(s1s+s2s)/2; N+=3-(s1s+s2s)/2
        d=[p for p in range(3) if c1[p]!=c2[p]]
        if not d: continue
        if len(d)==1:
            if CODON[c1]==CODON[c2]: Sd+=1
            else: Nd+=1
        else:
            paths=list(itertools.permutations(d)); sd=nd=0.0
            for path in paths:
                cur=c1
                for p in path:
                    nxt=cur[:p]+c2[p]+cur[p+1:]
                    if CODON[cur]==CODON[nxt]: sd+=1
                    else: nd+=1
                    cur=nxt
            Sd+=sd/len(paths); Nd+=nd/len(paths)
    pS=Sd/S; pN=Nd/N
    jc=lambda p: np.nan if p>=0.75 else -0.75*math.log(1-4*p/3)
    dS,dN=jc(pS),jc(pN)
    return dict(S=round(S,1),N=round(N,1),Sd=round(Sd,1),Nd=round(Nd,1),
                pN=round(pN,4),pS=round(pS,4),dN=round(dN,4),dS=round(dS,4),
                dN_dS=round(dN/dS,4) if dS and not np.isnan(dS) else np.nan)

loci={"AAD3":"YCR107W","AAD4":"YDL243C","AAD10":"YJR155W","AAD14":"YNL331C","AAD15":"YOL165C"}
cds={}
for g,o in loci.items():
    d=requests.get(f"https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/{o}/sequence_details",timeout=60).json()
    cds[g]=[e["residues"].upper() for e in d["genomic_dna"] if e["strain"]["display_name"]=="S288C"][0]
prot={g:tr(s).rstrip("*") for g,s in cds.items()}
rows=[]
for g1,g2 in itertools.combinations(loci,2):
    a,b=nw(prot[g1],prot[g2])
    i=j=0; cp=[]
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        if x!="-" and y!="-": cp.append((cds[g1][3*i:3*i+3],cds[g2][3*j:3*j+3]))
        if x!="-": i+=1
        if y!="-": j+=1
    r=ng(cp); r.update(pair=f"{g1}-{g2}",codons=len(cp)); rows.append(r)
dnds=pd.DataFrame(rows)[["pair","codons","N","S","Nd","Sd","pN","pS","dN","dS","dN_dS"]]
print("Between-paralog dN/dS (Nei-Gojobori, Jukes-Cantor corrected), S288C coding sequences:")
print(dnds.sort_values("dN_dS").to_string(index=False))
dnds.to_csv("aad_paralog_dnds.csv",index=False)

# ---------- figure ----------
seg=pd.DataFrame([dict(gene="AAD3",Nseg=29,Sseg=35,Nsites=859.41,Ssites=229.59,n_strains=9),
                  dict(gene="AAD4",Nseg=56,Sseg=104,Nsites=773.55,Ssites=204.45,n_strains=14),
                  dict(gene="AAD10",Nseg=6,Sseg=17,Nsites=682.03,Ssites=181.97,n_strains=11),
                  dict(gene="AAD14",Nseg=18,Sseg=41,Nsites=881.95,Ssites=243.05,n_strains=14)])
seg["pN_pS"]=(seg.Nseg/seg.Nsites)/(seg.Sseg/seg.Ssites)
pres=pd.Series({"AAD10":23,"AAD4":18,"AAD6":18,"AAD14":17,"AAD16":13,"AAD3":13,"AAD15":8})
cs=pd.DataFrame([("S. mikatae",90.4,"Y"),("S. kudriavzevii",88.6,"Y"),("S. eubayanus",83.4,"Y"),
                 ("L. thermotolerans",74.7,"Y"),("N. castellii",31.7,"Y"),("Z. rouxii",30.7,"Y"),
                 ("K. lactis",27.8,"Y"),("N. glabratus",25.6,"Y"),("S. arboricola",24.8,"Y"),
                 ("E. gossypii",24.0,"Y"),("T. delbrueckii",29.5,"Y")],
                columns=["species","pid","catTyr"]).sort_values("pid",ascending=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9))
ax=axes[0,0]
cols=["#e86b6b" if g=="AAD3" else "#6b93e8" for g in seg.gene]
ax.bar(seg.gene,seg.pN_pS,color=cols)
ax.axhline(1.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.set_ylabel("pN/pS (within S. cerevisiae)")
ax.set_title("AAD3 has the highest nonsynonymous polymorphism ratio,\nbut all four genes stay well below 1 (Fisher p=0.079 pooled)",fontsize=10)
for i,(g,v) in enumerate(zip(seg.gene,seg.pN_pS)): ax.text(i,v+0.01,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center")

ax=axes[0,1]
cols=["#e86b6b" if g in ("AAD3","AAD15") else "#6b93e8" for g in pres.index]
ax.bar(pres.index,pres.values,color=cols)
ax.set_ylabel("strain assemblies with an annotated copy")
ax.set_title("AAD3 and AAD15, the two most telomere-proximal loci,\nare annotated in the fewest SGD strain assemblies",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1,0]
d=dnds.sort_values("dN_dS")
ax.barh(d.pair,d.dN_dS,color=["#e86b6b" if "AAD3" in p else "#6b93e8" for p in d.pair])
ax.axvline(1.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.set_xlabel("dN/dS between paralogs (Nei-Gojobori)")
ax.set_title("All paralog pairs show dN/dS well below 1",fontsize=10)
for i,(p,v) in enumerate(zip(d.pair,d.dN_dS)): ax.text(v+0.005,i,f"{v:.3f}",va="center",fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1,1]
c=["#2e7d32" if v>70 else "#bbbbbb" for v in cs.pid]
ax.barh(cs.species,cs.pid,color=c)
ax.axvline(70,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.set_xlabel("% identity of closest AKR to Aad14")
ax.set_title("AAD-clade orthologs exist only in Saccharomyces sensu stricto\nand L. thermotolerans; every one keeps the catalytic Tyr",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
